steps.title: Pure policy and solver
scope: Add lib/responsive/camera-fit.ts, including the §4.3 optical-center invariant, and add the §7.B policy exports to lib/responsive/input-policy.ts plus the FOCUS_CAMERA_RESERVATIONS, bounds, and fallback-distance tokens to lib/responsive/hud-layout.ts.
Write tests/unit/camera-fit.test.ts, tests/unit/camera-fit-oracle.test.ts (§4.8), and the input-policy extensions first; existing input-policy tests must pass unmodified.
Verify AC-1, AC-4, AC-8, and the unit parts of AC-12, AC-14, and AC-15 without beginning authored framing points or runtime integration.

steps.title: Authored framing points
scope: Add the authored constants using the §2.2 octagon rule and the unified getFocusTarget() contract, including verticalBias, world-space scratch, and null fail-safe behavior, to turntable.ts, vinyl-crate.ts, and glass-mac.ts.
Keep the legacy scalar fields temporarily so the tree stays green.
Add unit fixtures and world-space, camera-free sweep property tests for AC-2 without integrating the fit solver into the live camera.

steps.title: Fit integration
scope: Wire the solver, the §5 cache with the tombstone and generation laws, focus-fit-store, and the §4.5 failure rule into globe-canvas.tsx and the hint overlays.

Preserve the full capture-branch guard wasFocused && focusKind !== m && modeT > 0.3, implement the §4.7 refit transition with REFIT_BLEND_S = 0.6 and REFIT_MAX_FRAME_STEP_S = 1/30, retire the scalar formulas and legacy fitHeight/fitDepth/fitWidth fields, and add the dev-only getFocusFit() hook.
Add e2e/phase5-fit.spec.ts and verify AC-3, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, and the AC-25 degraded path with all five required gates.

steps.title: Free-look rewire
scope: Replace the cockpit-hud.tsx free-look handler with the §7.A policy-driven mapping through hoverAngle() and responseExponentFor(), using the live visible-box origin, reduced-motion gating, and pointer-exit decay.
Add the dev-only getFreeLookState() hook and the hover coverage in e2e/phase5-input.spec.ts.
Verify AC-9, AC-10, AC-13, and the hover half of AC-18 without introducing contained-stage pan or changing the live window.__cockpit* bridge.

steps.title: Gesture arbitration
scope: Implement components/cockpit/pointer-activation.ts as the single canvas-level pointer arbiter with crate, deck, coffee, decorations, and PC priority order.

Migrate all five §1.5 handler sites, including the deck and crate click-away exits, to sub-slop pointerup click semantics; pointerdown must never be propagation-stopped, and slop uses maximum Euclidean displacement from the down position.
Verify AC-17 without beginning the contained-pan controller.

steps.title: Contained pan
scope: Implement components/responsive/use-contained-pan.ts and the §7.B accumulator over native scroll, sizeRatio gain, wheel modifier and normalization laws, pointer drag and capture, drag-release-only inertia, keyboard paths, reset, lifecycle cancellation, and the §7.B position law.

Add the fully specified §7.D instructions and RESET bar to ResponsiveStage with its stable every-mode wrapper, exact copy, theme and accessibility behavior, and no cockpit remount across tier transitions; add the dev-only getPanState() hook.
Verify AC-11, AC-12, AC-14, AC-15, AC-16, AC-18, AC-19, AC-21, and AC-29 with all five required gates.

steps.title: Suite registration and hygiene
scope: Register e2e/phase5-fit.spec.ts and e2e/phase5-input.spec.ts in .github/workflows/ci.yml for AC-26.
Run the AC-22, AC-23, and AC-24 bridge, production-exclusion, and phase-boundary greps, preserving the byte-identical 34-name window.__cockpit* bridge and the Phase 6 test.fixme.
Complete the AC-25 context-recovery test and run all five required gates.

steps.title: Docs, amendments, and delivery
scope: Apply amendment A3 and the Phase 5 current-state updates to docs/responsive-system.md, update CLAUDE.md current-flow notes without changing the bridge, and write docs/phase-5-implementation.md in the Phase 4 report format.
Prepare the unfilled docs/baselines/phase-5-input/OWNER-CHECKPOINT.template.md with AC-27, AC-28, and decision-history sections; never create or edit the dated owner checkpoint.
Capture the 12 AC-28 images into docs/baselines/phase-5-input/ac28/, run all five required gates, and stop at the owner gate with no commit.

steps.title: Owner acceptance and delivery
scope: After the owner authors and signs the dated checkpoint, verify only and never edit owner evidence: require exactly one dated file, complete AC-27 and AC-28 evidence referencing the step-8 captures, and a latest decision-history entry of approved with no later unresolved changes-requested.
Rerun all five required gates fresh and hand the complete live diff to independent Kimi QA.

Do not stage or commit; after independent QA PASS the controller owns the single implementation commit covering all Phase 5 production code, tests, documentation, and the complete docs/baselines/phase-5-input/ evidence tree.

commitAfterQa.message: Phase 5: implement 3D fit and input normalization
